Before your first hook.

What is NovaClient?+

A DDNet client built on DDNet and TClient, with prediction settings, gameplay tools, an editable HUD and personalization. Keep playing on DDNet-compatible servers.

How do I install it?+

Download the complete Windows x64 package from the releases page. Extract all files into a folder, then run DDNet.exe. Keep the DLLs and data folder alongside the executable.

Do I need a license?+

Yes. The client requires a valid license. Available Premium cosmetics and badge options depend on the role associated with your license.

Do these demos change my game?+

No. These controls work only in your browser. Configure NovaClient to use its features in the game. The 3D scenes and data on this page are illustrative demonstrations.
